🚆 One day of trains in the Netherlands — Thursday 15 October 2026.

6,338 trains on one of Europe's busiest networks: Sprinters and Intercitys every few minutes between Amsterdam, Utrecht, Rotterdam and The Hague, plus ICE and Eurostar heading abroad. Peaks: 437 trains on the move at 08:25, 441 at 17:25.

📊 Data: OVapi GTFS (NDOV open data), rail services only. Positions interpolated between stops; stations joined in straight lines.
🌍 Relief: AWS Terrain Tiles · Natural Earth.
